title: Raja Ki Aayegi Baaraat
desc: Raja rapes Mala and the court orders him to marry her. His family continues to torture Mala and attempts to kill her, but she manages to win over Raja and his family with her good deeds.

title: Lootera
desc: A story of a con artist, Varun who falls in love with Pakhi, daughter of a wealthy landowner. Varun and his partner deceive Pakhi's father by pretending to be archaeologists in search of a hidden treasure. But their plan goes awry when Varun starts to develop genuine feelings for Pakhi. Their love story is a poignant and tragic tale of sacrifice and redemption.

title: Maine Dil Tujhko Diya
desc: Ajay loves Ayesha but her father does not approve of Ajay and decides to marry her off to his business partner's son instead. When Ajay persists, her father hires a goon to kill him.

title: Pyar Ki Takkar (dub) (aranmanai Kaavalan -Tamil)
desc: A large family returns to an ancestral property (palace) to sell it off. Meanwhile they discover some supernatural elements in the palace.
